title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第二十九章、真话还是疯话

    “狸猫换太子”的白旗飘扬在菜市场的大门上空。
    公孙策站在包拯旁边，小声地问：“楚珠真的会来？”
    包拯点头：“我相信她会来。”
    夜越来越黑，不知道什么时候，风停了，雪飘了下来。雪越下越大，像是天上破了一个巨大的洞，雪从洞里掉下来，纷纷扬扬飞向大地。雪没有声音，但气场一点儿都不弱，天地之间仿佛有种无声的力量在回响。
    人群打着伞聚在四周，大雪没有让他们离去，相反，从家里赶来看热闹的人越来越多了。人们都在等一场大戏，而那戏的主角——要敲登闻鼓的人，却始终没有出现。
    不知过了多久，人群后面突然亮起一大片灯光。一队人抬着一个小担架朝这边走了过来。他们是宫里的太监和侍卫，走在最前面的那个是太监总管张怀。
    张怀看了看登闻鼓，走到包拯面前，笑着问：“包大人，您在这儿做什么呢？”
    包拯没有看张怀，他的目光落在侍卫们抬着的那个小担架上。那上面躺了一个人，但被黑布盖住了。
    “太后让我给您送个人来。”张怀指了指担架，一个小太监上去把担架上的黑布拿开了。
    担架上躺着的人露了出来，是个瘦弱的老女人，全身湿透，像是刚从水里提上来的。因为天气太冷，破旧的衣服和满头白发都结了冰，暗沉的脸上也有一层冰。她闭着眼睛，像是睡着了，但所有的人都看得出来，她已经死了。
    “蓝香！”公孙策惊叫。
    包拯也震惊了，他转向张怀，怒火在胸中翻滚：“是你杀了她？”
    张怀摇头：“不是我，是太后要她死，因为她在宫里说疯话。”
    “她说的是真话！”
    “不，那是疯话。”张怀看了看半空里的白旗，摇头道：“包大人，您也在说疯话。”他对身后的侍卫摆了摆手，命令道：“把它拿下来！”
    “你敢！”包拯伸开双手拦在门下，愤怒道：“谁也不许动！”
    “太后的命令！立刻把包拯抓起来！”张怀喊道。
    侍卫们立刻全部跑过来抓包拯。
    “我看你们今天谁敢动包拯！”公孙策拿着一个长木杆大喊着拦在包拯前面，他满目愤怒，面带杀气，侍卫们看了都有些害怕。
    “笨蛋！一个书生你们怕什么？把公孙策也一起抓了！”张怀大骂。
    侍卫们这才反应过来，马上围上来抓公孙策。
fullText.traditional:
第二十九章、真話還是瘋話

    “狸貓換太子”的白旗飄揚在菜市場的大門上空。
    公孫策站在包拯旁邊，小聲地問：“楚珠真的會來？”
    包拯點頭：“我相信她會來。”
    夜越來越黑，不知道什麼時候，風停了，雪飄了下來。雪越下越大，像是天上破了一個巨大的洞，雪從洞裡掉下來，紛紛揚揚飛向大地。雪沒有聲音，但氣場一點兒都不弱，天地之間彷彿有種無聲的力量在迴響。
    人群打著傘聚在四周，大雪沒有讓他們離去，相反，從家裡趕來看熱鬧的人越來越多了。人們都在等一場大戲，而那戲的主角——要敲登聞鼓的人，卻始終沒有出現。
    不知過了多久，人群後面突然亮起一大片燈光。一隊人抬著一個小擔架朝這邊走了過來。他們是宮裡的太監和侍衛，走在最前面的那個是太監總管張懷。
    張懷看了看登聞鼓，走到包拯面前，笑著問：“包大人，您在這兒做什麼呢？”
    包拯沒有看張懷，他的目光落在侍衛們抬著的那個小擔架上。那上面躺了一個人，但被黑布蓋住了。
    “太后讓我給您送個人來。”張懷指了指擔架，一個小太監上去把擔架上的黑布拿開了。
    擔架上躺著的人露了出來，是個瘦弱的老女人，全身濕透，像是剛從水裡提上來的。因為天氣太冷，破舊的衣服和滿頭白髮都結了冰，暗沉的臉上也有一層冰。她閉著眼睛，像是睡著了，但所有的人都看得出來，她已經死了。
    “藍香！”公孫策驚叫。
    包拯也震驚了，他轉向張懷，怒火在胸中翻滾：“是你殺了她？”
    張懷搖頭：“不是我，是太后要她死，因為她在宮裡說瘋話。”
    “她說的是真話！”
    “不，那是瘋話。”張懷看了看半空裡的白旗，搖頭道：“包大人，您也在說瘋話。”他對身後的侍衛擺了擺手，命令道：“把它拿下來！”
    “你敢！”包拯伸開雙手攔在門下，憤怒道：“誰也不許動！”
    “太后的命令！立刻把包拯抓起來！”張懷喊道。
    侍衛們立刻全部跑過來抓包拯。
    “我看你們今天誰敢動包拯！”公孫策拿著一個長木桿大喊著攔在包拯前面，他滿目憤怒，面帶殺氣，侍衛們看了都有些害怕。
    “笨蛋！一個書生你們怕什麼？把公孫策也一起抓了！”張懷大罵。
    侍衛們這才反應過來，馬上圍上來抓公孫策。

sentences.traditional: “我看你們今天誰敢動包拯！”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ kàn nǐ men jīn tiān shéi gǎn dòng bāo zhěng
sentences.english: “Let’s see who dares to touch Bao Zheng today!”

sentences.simplified: 公孙策拿着一个长木杆大喊着拦在包拯前面，
sentences.traditional: 公孫策拿著一個長木桿大喊著攔在包拯前面，
sentences.pinyin: gōng sūn cè ná zhe yí ge cháng mù gān dà hǎn zhe lán zài bāo zhěng qián miàn
sentences.english: Gongsun Ce blocked the way in front of Bao Zheng holding a long wooden pole and shouting.

sentences.simplified: 他满目愤怒，面带杀气，侍卫们看了都有些害怕。
sentences.traditional: 他滿目憤怒，面帶殺氣，侍衛們看了都有些害怕。
sentences.pinyin: tā mǎn mù fèn nù miàn dài shā qì shì wèi men kàn le dōu yǒu xiē hài pà
sentences.english: His eyes were full of anger, and his face was murderous. The guards were a bit afraid when they saw this.

sentences.simplified: “笨蛋！一个书生你们怕什么？把公孙策也一起抓了！”张怀大骂。
sentences.traditional: “笨蛋！一個書生你們怕什麼？把公孫策也一起抓了！”張懷大罵。
sentences.pinyin: bèn dàn yí ge shū shēng nǐ men pà shén me bǎ gōng sūn cè yě yì qǐ zhuā le zhāng huái dà mà
sentences.english: “Fools! Why are you afraid of a mere scholar? Arrest Gongsun Ce as well!” Zhang Huai cursed.

sentences.simplified: 侍卫们这才反应过来，马上围上来抓公孙策。
sentences.traditional: 侍衛們這才反應過來，馬上圍上來抓公孫策。
sentences.pinyin: shì wèi men zhè cái fǎn yìng guò lái mǎ shàng wéi shàng lái zhuā gōng sūn cè
sentences.english: The guards only then reacted, immediately surrounding and arresting Gongsun Ce.

sentence_translations: Chapter 29: Truth or Nonsense
The white banner that said “exchanging a leopard cat for a prince” fluttered above the gate of the market.
Gongsun Ce stood next to Bao Zheng and asked in a low voice, “Will Chu Zhu really come?”
Bao Zheng nodded, “I believe she will come.”
The night grew darker and darker. At some point, the wind stopped, and the snow began to fall.
The snow was falling heavier and heavier, as if a huge hole had opened up in the sky, ..
.. with snowflakes pouring down from it, fluttering towards the earth.
The snow was silent, but its presence was not weak at all. It felt as if a silent force was resonating between heaven and earth.
The crowd gathered around holding umbrellas. The heavy snow did not make them leave.
On the contrary, more and more people rushed from their homes to watch the excitement.
Everyone was waiting for a grand show, ..
.. but the protagonist of the show—the person who was supposed to beat the petitioners’ drum, never appeared.
No one knew how much time had passed when suddenly a large area of lights lit up behind the crowd.
A group of people carrying a small stretcher were walking in this direction.
They were the eunuchs and guards from the palace, and leading them was the chief eunuch, Zhang Huai.
Zhang Huai looked at the petitioners’ drum, walked up to Bao Zheng, and asked with a smile, “Lord Bao, what are you doing here?”
Bao Zheng did not look at Zhang Huai. His gaze fell on the small stretcher carried by the guards.
There was a person lying on the stretcher, but the person was covered with a black cloth.
“The empress dowager asked me to bring someone to you.”
Zhang Huai pointed at the stretcher, and a young eunuch went up to take the black cloth off of the stretcher.
The person lying on the stretcher was revealed.
It was a frail old woman, completely soaked, as if she had just been pulled out of the water.
Because the weather was so cold, her tattered clothes and white hair were covered in ice.
There was also a layer of ice on her dull face.
Her eyes were closed as if she was asleep, but everyone could tell that she was already dead.
“Lan Xiang!” Gongsun Ce cried out in shock.
Bao Zheng was also shocked. He turned towards Zhang Huai, anger boiling in his chest: “It was you who killed her?”
Zhang Huai shook his head:
“It wasn’t me. It was the empress dowager who wanted her dead because she was speaking nonsense in the palace.”
“She was telling the truth!”
“No, that was nonsense.”
Zhang Huai looked at the white banner in the sky and shook his head, saying, “Lord Bao, you are also speaking nonsense.”
He waved his hand at the guards behind him and ordered, “Take it down!”
“Don’t you dare!” Bao Zheng spread his arms to block the gate, angrily saying, “No one is allowed to move!”
“This is the empress dowager’s command! Arrest Bao Zheng immediately!” Zhang Huai shouted.
The guards immediately ran over to arrest Bao Zheng.
“Let’s see who dares to touch Bao Zheng today!”
Gongsun Ce blocked the way in front of Bao Zheng holding a long wooden pole and shouting.
His eyes were full of anger, and his face was murderous. The guards were a bit afraid when they saw this.
“Fools! Why are you afraid of a mere scholar? Arrest Gongsun Ce as well!” Zhang Huai cursed.
The guards only then reacted, immediately surrounding and arresting Gongsun Ce.
